summary: Add Python tool for robust answer extraction (ANSWER: prefix and markdown handling)

edits.hypothesis: A deterministic Python tool that extracts answers by detecting ANSWER: patterns and stripping markdown formatting will robustly recover correct answers from various output styles, improving format compliance without system instruction changes that previously caused ledger task regressions
edits.targets_mode: output_format_non_compliance: model wraps answer in narrative or markdown despite task format specifications; extraction via deterministic tool avoids the regression pattern from system instruction modifications in round 0
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Answer extraction is deterministic string/pattern matching, not something the frozen model can be instructed to do differently; tool-based post-processing isolates this concern from model reasoning, whereas system/prompt changes triggered regressions on ledger tasks by affecting inference behavior
edits.trigger_condition: Tool activates on every solve() call; processes the last non-empty line of model output to detect ANSWER: prefix (case-insensitive) or markdown bold/italic formatting before returning extracted answer
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) evolve-logic-002 would pass if model outputs 'ANSWER: Sawyer' or '**Sawyer**' variants within final line—tool extracts to 'Sawyer'; (preservative) tool is purely post-processing and does not modify model reasoning, so constraint-anchoring and scenario-enumeration habits in logic-006 remain intact; ledger arithmetic reasoning is unaffected by deterministic extraction; (transfer) tool is task-family-agnostic; handles ANSWER: prefix or markdown in any domain
edits.regression_risk: Regex edge cases (nested markdown, unusual delimiters) could mismatch; mitigated by defensive fallback that returns stripped last line if no pattern matches, preserving baseline behavior
edits.mechanism: A deterministic Python tool that extracts answers by detecting ANSWER: patterns and stripping markdown formatting will robustly recover correct answers from various output styles, improving format compliance without system instruction changes that previously caused ledger task regressions
